reason: All key premises are directly and accurately supported by the cited evidence from E1, which reports the specific inhibition efficiencies, concentration and temperature dependence, mixed-type behavior, and the physisorption/chemisorption mechanism confirmed by XPS. E2 and E3 provide background but are not needed for the core claims.
premises: N,S-CDs act as mixed-type corrosion inhibitors for Q235 steel in 1 M HCl
Inhibition efficiency increases with N,S-CD concentration, reaching ~96.6% at 400 ppm and 25°C
Inhibition efficiency from weight loss increases with temperature from 25 to 55°C
Protection arises from physisorption and chemisorption of N,S-CDs forming a protective layer
The adsorption follows the Langmuir isotherm
